text: eBayes produces object class MArrayLM (see MArrayLM-class) containing everything found fit plus following added components: t numeric matrix moderated t-statistics. p.value numeric matrix two-sided p-values corresponding t-statistics. lods numeric matrix giving log-odds differential expression (natural log scale). s2.prior estimated prior value sigma^2. row-wise vector covariate non-NULL, otherwise single value. df.prior degrees freedom associated s2.prior. row-wise vector robust=TRUE, otherwise single value. df.total row-wise numeric vector giving total degrees freedom associated t-statistics gene. Equal df.prior+df.residual sum(df.residual), whichever smaller. s2.post row-wise numeric vector giving posterior values sigma^2. var.prior column-wise numeric vector giving estimated prior values variance log2-fold-changes differentially expressed gene constrast. Used evaluating lods. F row-wise numeric vector moderated F-statistics testing contrasts defined columns fit simultaneously equal zero. F.p.value row-wise numeric vector giving p-values corresponding F. matrices t, p.value lods dimensions input object fit, rows corresponding genes columns coefficients contrasts. vectors s2.prior, df.prior, df.total, F F.p.value correspond rows, length equal number genes. vector var.prior corresponds columns, length equal number contrasts. s2.prior df.prior length 1, value applies genes. s2.prior, df.prior var.prior contain empirical Bayes hyperparameters used obtain df.total, s2.post lods.
